title: Vitamux healthkit.samples.v1 item body
description: Body of one ingest item of stream healthkit.samples.v1: one HKAnchoredObjectQuery page of one type, as sent by HealthBridgeKit (apple/HealthBridgeKit). Raw HealthKit values in the units of the type registry; the server converts. Percent types are fractions (0.97), as HealthKit reports them. Only additive, optional changes within v1. See docs/architecture/apple-health.md#payload.

type.description: Full HealthKit identifier, e.g. HKQuantityTypeIdentifierHeartRate, HKCorrelationTypeIdentifierBloodPressure, HKWorkoutTypeIdentifier.

before_hash.description: Hash of the anchor the query started from; none for a full pull.

type.description: HealthKit type identifier; set on correlation members only.

start.description: RFC 3339 with the offset of HKTimeZone, else of the phone.

value.description: Quantity in unit, or the raw category value (no unit).

unit.description: HKUnit string, e.g. count/min, mmHg, %, degC, mg/dL.

device.description: HKDevice, when the writer set one.

metadata.description: HealthKit metadata: numbers (booleans as 0/1), strings; dates as RFC 3339 UTC, quantities as their description.

totals.description: Sums by quantity type identifier, in the registry unit.
